_comment: Reservoir of distinct, non-cannibalizing blog angles for arisepal.com. The cron pops the oldest status:queued item each run, writes it, sets status:published with the slug + date, and never repeats. Each keyword is a long-tail or local angle NOT owned by a money page, a city page, or an existing post (see keyword-map.md). When fewer than 8 remain queued, the cron generates 6 to 10 fresh angles in the same spirit and appends them.
